consequence.statement: The setting already did nothing, so removing it from the istio-cni configmap has no operational effect.

original.statement: The CNI_NET_DIR key was removed from the istio-cni configmap because it no longer has any effect.

decision.reason: [ev-191d17c9702d] says `CNI_NET_DIR` was removed from the `istio-cni` configmap "as it now does nothing". That means the key has no function, so removing it has no operational effect and "none" (informational) fits. P1's setting-ignored would claim mandatory work, and nothing in the evidence says a value an operator relied on stops being honoured. Confidence is low because the word "now" does not say which release made the key stop working.
